issues.finding: The proposed acceptance corpus requires historical mode authentication that existing packet representations do not supply.
evidence: tools/test_historical_symlink_packet.py:67–71 requires validate_packet to reject old_mode changed from 120000 to 100644.
tools/convergent_review.py:598 validates old_mode against an enum; lines 605–607 bind old content to byte length, SHA-256 and Git blob OID. A blob OID does not bind Git tree mode.
tools/convergent_review.py:816–857 authenticates the head tree only. Deleted historical entries have no authenticated base-tree mode.
Independent temporary Git fixture probe accepted old_mode 120000→100644 for a deleted safe link under both versions 1.0.0 and 1.1.0, in both ordinary and full_audit modes.
issues.required_fix: Resolve the authentication boundary before approval. The smallest compatible repair can preserve trusted-builder-derived historical mode and existing content consistency checks while explicitly disclaiming standalone base-tree mode authentication. Remove the incompatible mode-tamper assertion under that boundary. If historical mode must be cryptographically authenticated, separately propose the necessary base commit/tree proof, schema/version and consumer changes for Loop 1 review.

issues.finding: The contract leaves the supported historical-target language and limits undefined.
evidence: .agent/contracts/AI-PIPELINE-historical-symlink-packet.json:34 refers to supported historical link bytes.
The same contract:37 requires explicit malformed, binary and oversized limits but does not define them.
tools/convergent_review.py:433–437 currently combines single-path text validity with safe relative-path access restrictions.
The authored corpus tests invalid UTF-8 only at tools/test_historical_symlink_packet.py:122–125.
issues.required_fix: Specify the inert historical text boundary, including empty content, NUL, CR/LF, other controls, absolute/drive/backslash targets, UTF-8 handling and byte limits. State precisely which fail closed and which remain exact inert evidence.

missing_acceptance_coverage.requirement: Existing packet versions and consumer compatibility
missing_acceptance_coverage.evidence: tools/test_historical_symlink_packet.py:43 defaults every packet to explicit 1.1.0; there are no 1.0.0 or auto-version historical tests. The builder selects 1.0.0 for text-only packets at tools/convergent_review.py:2141.
missing_acceptance_coverage.required_fix: Cover explicit 1.0.0, explicit 1.1.0 and auto selection, with version-appropriate assertions. Define compatibility as preservation of existing accepted packets and consumers after official adoption; distinguish this from unsupported old consumers accepting the newly allowed evidence.

missing_acceptance_coverage.required_fix: Add explicit candidate and transition coverage in full_audit, including an unchanged unsafe surviving symlink, same-content mode transitions, and an unsafe renamed destination.
